scope: Independent visual completeness check of the single 兔 row in the publisher's public supplementary writing-note PDF. No animation or geometry approval.

source.accessStatus: Public publisher download successfully fetched into RAM by platform curl with normal certificate verification.

independentFreshRender.method: The independently fetched ZIP was held in a process buffer, its PDF extracted in RAM, and page index 110 rendered by pypdfium2. The row crop was emitted and visually inspected.
independentFreshRender.cropEncoding: WebP quality 90 from the direct PDF raster

sharedRamRender.method: Before the fresh retrieval, independently viewed the primary researcher's local RAM page render and enlarged adjacent cumulative cells. The server's full-page WebP was decoded, cropped, and re-encoded.
sharedRamRender.renderHashNote: The shared-server row crop and direct-PDF row crop have different hashes because the former includes an extra full-page WebP encode/decode. ZIP and PDF source hashes match exactly.

inspection.observedRowStructure: Headword 兔 with reading 토, row 391, eight distinct small cumulative forms progressing from a single dark upper folded-hook shape to the complete dark glyph; grey complete-glyph guides remain in unfinished areas. Larger pale tracing forms below are not counted as cumulative stages.

stepChanges.observation: 위쪽 가로와 오른쪽으로 꺾여 내려오는 갈고리 모양만 검정이다. 그 아래 왼삐침 및 나머지 자형은 회색으로 남는다.
윗부분 안쪽에서 왼쪽 아래로 뻗는 삐침이 검정으로 추가된다. 첫 칸과의 차이가 확대 화면에서 명확하다.
중간 네모꼴의 왼쪽 짧은 세로가 검정으로 추가된다.
중간 네모꼴의 윗가로와 오른쪽으로 꺾여 내려오는 부분이 검정으로 추가된다. 밑가로는 아직 회색이다.
stepChanges.newDarkStrokeShape: top and folded right side of middle enclosure

stepChanges.observation: 중간 네모꼴의 밑가로가 검정으로 추가되어 네모꼴 테두리가 닫힌다.
중간 네모꼴을 관통하여 왼쪽 아래로 길게 빠지는 곡선이 검정으로 추가된다. 오른쪽 아래 굽은 부분과 작은 점은 아직 회색이다.
오른쪽 아래로 내려가 바닥을 돌고 끝에서 올라오는 굽은 갈고리가 검정으로 추가된다. 그 안쪽 작은 점은 회색이다.
아래 오른쪽 굽은 부분 안쪽의 작은 독립 점이 검정으로 추가된다. 모든 자형이 완성된다.

inspection.glyphObservation: The headword and eighth cumulative form show 兔 with a separate small dot. The observed row is the exact requested rabbit glyph rather than a substituted 兎 row.

limitations: This confirms the complete eight-stage static publisher diagram, not timing, continuous pen motion, stroke-width geometry, or the correctness of any generated animation.
The independent view covered the row crop and enlarged cumulative cells of PDF page 111, not all 165 PDF pages.
The printed page number was supplied by the primary researcher; this peer directly bound the row to zero-based PDF page 110 and independently read row number 391.

Initial Node and bundled-Python downloads failed normal TLS issuer-chain verification. Neither was weakened or bypassed. The later platform curl retrieval succeeded with default verification and no -k option.
No source image or video is stored in this metadata-only artifact.
